description: The brightest star of M73, a chance alignment of stars once thought to be a small cluster.

temperature.source: Gaia DR3 astrophysical parameters (CDS I/355/paramp), source 6888761925104124544: Teff 4821.1 K from the BP/RP spectra (GSP-Phot)

text.card: The brightest star of M73, a chance alignment of stars once thought to be a small cluster.
text.introduction: M73 (NGC 6994) is an asterism: its stars lie at different distances and are not bound to each other.
text.locator: Title and abstract: NGC 6994 = M73 is clearly not a physical stellar ensemble

notes: M73 has no package of its own: it is a chance alignment of unrelated stars. Its three brightest are drawn as bodies; Gaia DR3 publishes no temperature or radius for the next (Gaia DR3 6888762676722910720), so it is left out.
